reason_for_correction: The initial gate encoded two storage-level assumptions that contradict the exact released Dolphin/lenstronomy interfaces. This addendum changes only those two interface invariants; it does not change any likelihood, predictive, rank, stability, held-out, injection, or negative-control threshold.

mask_correction.initial_incorrect_invariant: the standalone F435W mask HDF5 must equal the settings custom_mask bit-for-bit
mask_correction.observed_storage_relation: the standalone 120x120 mask is exactly one minus the reshaped first-band custom_mask: 91 ones versus 91 zeros, with zero disagreeing pixels after complement

released_Dolphin_evidence.semantics: ModelConfig.get_masks constructs the operative likelihood mask from coordinates and multiplies it directly by the flattened settings custom_mask before array2image; it never reads the standalone mask HDF5

corrected_invariants: the standalone F435W mask equals one minus reshape(settings custom_mask[0]) bit-for-bit
the operative likelihood mask is reconstructed only by the locked ModelConfig.get_masks implementation
the standalone mask cannot replace, invert, or modify the generated likelihood mask

PSF_correction.initial_incorrect_invariant: each raw released PSF stamp must already sum to one within 1e-6

released_lenstronomy_evidence.semantics: PSF(..., kernel_point_source_normalisation=True) is the default and divides the pixel kernel by its sum during initialization

corrected_invariants: each raw PSF is finite, nonnegative, 61x61, odd-sized, and has finite positive total flux
the locked lenstronomy PSF initializer receives the raw stamp with its default normalization enabled
the instantiated operative kernel sums to one within 1e-12 and preserves shape

unchanged_scientific_gates: masked and held-out predictive chi-square ceilings

Dolphin_packaging_correction.observed_failure: Installing the locked v0.0.1 source archive as a normal wheel produced dolphin 0.0.0 without dolphin.processor.
Dolphin_packaging_correction.released_source_cause: The locked setup.py packages list contains only the top-level dolphin package and omits the processor and analysis subpackages.
Dolphin_packaging_correction.Project_Dinos_execution_evidence: The pinned Project Dinos example notebook imports from dolphin.processor, consistent with running Dolphin from a source checkout rather than the incomplete built wheel.
Dolphin_packaging_correction.corrected_environment_method: Safely extract the checksum-locked commit archive without modifying it and install that exact root in editable/source-root mode so Python can resolve the released subpackages.

Astropy_compatibility_correction.observed_failure: lenstronomy 1.11.5 imports astropy.cosmology.utils.isiterable, which is absent from the initially resolved Astropy 6.1.7.
Astropy_compatibility_correction.reason: Astropy 5.3.4 is a Python 3.10-compatible pre-removal release that supplies the interface required by the locked lenstronomy source.

candidate_bundle_interface_boundary.observed_failure: The high-level Processor constructor requires a sample-wide lens_list.txt that is not part of the locked single-candidate bundle.
candidate_bundle_interface_boundary.corrected_audit_method: Instantiate the exact released ImageData, PSFData, and ModelConfig classes that Processor calls internally, using the locked J1402 paths directly.

PSF_float32_normalization_correction.cause: The locked lenstronomy implementation normalizes the released big-endian float32 kernels in place, so the operative arrays retain float32 rounding.
